name: Tracy's Blessed Hands Salon
description: A faith-centered salon led by Tracy Allen, bringing 35+ years of experience in healthy hair care and beautiful transformations to every client who sits in her chair.

hero.title: You are beautifully and wonderfully made.
hero.subtitle: Healthy hair care and stunning transformations from hands with 35+ years of experience — book your appointment today.

stylists.name: Tracy Allen
stylists.title: Owner & Lead Stylist
stylists.bio: With 35+ years in healthy hair care and hair transformations, Tracy founded Blessed Hands on a simple belief: beautiful hair is her ministry. Expect boss-lady energy, expert hands, and a chair where you leave feeling as beautiful as you were made.

reviews.name: Denise W.
reviews.text: Ms. Tracy is truly blessed! My silk press was flawless and my hair has never felt healthier. You can feel the love in that salon.

reviews.name: Keisha M.
reviews.text: I came in wanting a short cut with some color and she gave me exactly the look I had in my head. I've been getting compliments all week.

reviews.name: Angela R.
reviews.text: Over 35 years of experience and it shows. Professional, on time, and she really cares about the health of your hair.

reviews.name: Tonya B.
reviews.text: Such a warm, uplifting atmosphere. I walk out feeling beautiful inside and out every single time.
